key=prayer count=115 positions=[1696429, 1696449, 1696563, 1696584, 1696876, 1698365, 1698384, 1698404, 1698426, 1698467, 1698494, 1717258]

---
LocalTrafficUpdate(),
    refreshExternalHeadlineFeeds()
  ]);
  const prayerTimes = tickerFetches[0] && tickerFetches[0].status === 'fulfilled'
    ? tickerFetches[0].value
    : null;

  tickerSlotCounter += 1;

  const rawItem = String(Storage.get('rotastic_breaking_news_item', '') || '').trim();
  const meta = getActiveTickerMeta();

  // Live rota changes are highlighted in the same top ticker with a distinct style.
  const rotaAlert = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_rota_change_alert', null);
  if (rotaAlert && rotaAlert.message && Number(rotaAlert.expiresAt || 0) > Date.now()) {
    if (tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
      renderTickerCard('rota', rotaAlert.message, 8500);
      return;
    }
  }

  // In the final 30 minutes, insert a concise, positive personal message plus
  // tomorrow's rota note without stopping the existing ticker/news rotation.
  const lastThirtyMessage = getLastThirtyMinuteTickerMessage();
  if (lastThirtyMessage && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('general', lastThirtyMessage, getTickerDisplayDuration(lastThirtyMessage, 7200));
    return;
  }
  const sickPriority = getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta);
  const isSickPriorityActive = rawItem && meta.kind === 'sick' && sickPriority.active;
  const isAdminNotice = rawItem && meta.kind === 'admin';

  const prayerMoment = getPrayerMomentAlert(prayerTimes);
  if (prayerMoment && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 1 && !isSickPriorityActive) {
    renderFullWidthTickerTakeover(
      'prayerMoment',
      prayerMoment.message,
      6500
    );
    return;
  }

  // Normal stream: fixed category order, shuffled content inside each category:
  // Every cycle includes motivational lines and practical clinical advice.
  // 0 Greeting (brief)
  // 1 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 2 Relevant prayer
  // 3 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 4 Positive safe-practice advice
  // 5 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 6 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // 7 Greeting (brief, different positive line)
  // 8 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 9 Current QNA / Al Jazeera headline
  // 10 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 11 Positive doctor encouragement
  // 12 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 13 NHS global/relevant health item
  // 14 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // then repeat.
  // This makes public-health statistics and medical news much more visible.

  if (isAdminNotice && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('admin', conciseTickerText(rawItem, 105), 6500);
    return;
  }

  const cycleStep = rotasticContentCycleIndex % 15;
  rotasticContentCycleIndex = (rotasticContentCycleIndex + 1) % 15;

  if (cycleStep === 0 || cycleStep === 7) {
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 1 || cycleStep === 5 || cycleStep === 10) {
    rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount += 1;

    // Keep the stream focused on public-health numbers. Qatar fun facts remain
    // occasional rather than replacing a quarter of the medical-stat slots.
    const stat = chooseWeightedMedicalStat();
    if (stat) {
      renderTickerCard('stat', stat, 6000);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 2) {
    const prayerMessage = getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes);
    if (prayerMessage) {
      renderTickerCard('prayer', conciseTickerText(prayerMessage, 98), 6000);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 3 || cycleStep === 8 || cycleStep === 12) {
    rotasticCpdSlotCounter += 1;
    if (rotasticCpdSlotCounter % 4 === 1) {
      const cpdEvent = chooseActiveCpdEvent();
      if (cpdEvent) {
        rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = cpdEvent.link;
        rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'CPD event', domain:(new URL(cpdEvent.link)).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')};
        renderTickerCard('medicalnews', cpdEvent.text, 7600);
        return;
      }
    }

    const medicalHeadline = chooseLatestMedicalHeadline();

    if (medicalHeadline) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', medicalHeadline, 6500);
      return;
    }

    // This branch should be rare because chooseLatestMedicalHeadline also has
    // trusted-source landing-page fallbacks.
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 4) {
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 6 || cycleStep === 14) {
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 9) {
    const headline = chooseWorldHeadlineWithSource();

    if (headline) {
      renderTickerCard(headline.type, headline.text, 6300);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 11) {
    const weatherUpdate = getActualDohaWeatherTickerText();
    if (weatherUpdate && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0) {
      rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta = {name:'Doha Weather', domain:'open-meteo.com'};
      renderTickerCard('general', weatherUpdate, 7800);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 13) {
    const evidenceItem = (tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0)
      ? (chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() || chooseNhsRelevantHeadline())
      : (chooseNhsRelevantHeadline() || chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem());
    if (evidenceItem) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', evidenceItem, 8200);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
}

function renderQuietShiftTicker() {
  renderNextTickerSlot();
}

let headlineTickerTimer = null;

const ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt = Date.now();
let rotasticRoomHeroTimer = null;

function getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor() {
  const doctor = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const day = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!doctor || !day) return null;

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(day, doctor);
  if (!timing) return null;

  const shift = day[timing.period];
  if (!shift) return null;

  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, doctor);
  if (!rooms.length) return null;

  return {
    rooms: rooms,
    period: timing.period,
    shiftLabel: timing.label,
    day: day
  };
}

function renderMainRoomHero() {
  const card = document.getElementById('mainRoomHero');
  const number = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroNumber');
  const context = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroContext');
  if (!card || !number || !context) return;

  const remaining = ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS - (Date.now() - rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt);
  const info = getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor();

  if (remaining <= 0 || !info) {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  number.textContent = info.rooms.join(' / ');
  context.textContent =
    info.rooms.length === 1
      ? info.shiftLabel + ' • keep this room in mind for your first part of the shift'
      : info.shiftLabel + ' • multiple room allocations today';

  card.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (rotasticRoomHeroTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticRoomHeroTimer);
  rotasticRoomHeroTimer = setTimeout(function() {

  rotasticContentCycleIndex = (rotasticContentCycleIndex + 1) % 15;

  if (cycleStep === 0 || cycleStep === 7) {
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 1 || cycleStep === 5 || cycleStep === 10) {
    rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount += 1;

    // Keep the stream focused on public-health numbers. Qatar fun facts remain
    // occasional rather than replacing a quarter of the medical-stat slots.
    const stat = chooseWeightedMedicalStat();
    if (stat) {
      renderTickerCard('stat', stat, 6000);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 2) {
    const prayerMessage = getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes);
    if (prayerMessage) {
      renderTickerCard('prayer', conciseTickerText(prayerMessage, 98), 6000);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 3 || cycleStep === 8 || cycleStep === 12) {
    rotasticCpdSlotCounter += 1;
    if (rotasticCpdSlotCounter % 4 === 1) {
      const cpdEvent = chooseActiveCpdEvent();
      if (cpdEvent) {
        rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = cpdEvent.link;
        rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'CPD event', domain:(new URL(cpdEvent.link)).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')};
        renderTickerCard('medicalnews', cpdEvent.text, 7600);
        return;
      }
    }

    const medicalHeadline = chooseLatestMedicalHeadline();

    if (medicalHeadline) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', medicalHeadline, 6500);
      return;
    }

    // This branch should be rare because chooseLatestMedicalHeadline also has
    // trusted-source landing-page fallbacks.
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 4) {
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 6 || cycleStep === 14) {
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 9) {
    const headline = chooseWorldHeadlineWithSource();

    if (headline) {
      renderTickerCard(headline.type, headline.text, 6300);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 11) {
    const weatherUpdate = getActualDohaWeatherTickerText();
    if (weatherUpdate && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0) {
      rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta = {name:'Doha Weather', domain:'open-meteo.com'};
      renderTickerCard('general', weatherUpdate, 7800);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 13) {
    const evidenceItem = (tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0)
      ? (chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() || chooseNhsRelevantHeadline())
      : (chooseNhsRelevantHeadline() || chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem());
    if (evidenceItem) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', evidenceItem, 8200);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
}

function renderQuietShiftTicker() {
  renderNextTickerSlot();
}

let headlineTickerTimer = null;
let headlineTickerPhase = 'stream';




const ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt = Date.now();
let rotasticRoomHeroTimer = null;

function getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor() {
  const doctor = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const day = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!doctor || !day) return null;

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(day, doctor);
  if (!timing) return null;

  const shift = day[timing.period];
  if (!shift) return null;

  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, doctor);
  if (!rooms.length) return null;

  return {
    rooms: rooms,
    period: timing.period,
    shiftLabel: timing.label,
    day: day
  };
}

function renderMainRoomHero() {
  const card = document.getElementById('mainRoomHero');
  const number = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroNumber');
  const context = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroContext');
  if (!card || !number || !context) return;

  const remaining = ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS - (Date.now() - rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt);
  const info = getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor();

  if (remaining <= 0 || !info) {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  number.textContent = info.rooms.join(' / ');
  context.textContent =
    info.rooms.length === 1
      ? info.shiftLabel + ' • keep this room in mind for your first part of the shift'
      : info.shiftLabel + ' • multiple room allocations today';

  card.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (rotasticRoomHeroTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticRoomHeroTimer);
  rotasticRoomHeroTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
  }, remaining);
}

const ROTASTIC_SHIFT_WISHES = [
  'Wishing you a safe and smooth shift today.',
  'Hope today

---
ction startOpeningTickerSequence() {
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

  if (rotasticLaunchNotificationQueue.length) {
    Promise.resolve(renderNextTickerSlot()).catch(function(e) {
      console.warn('ROTASTIC launch notification ticker:', e);
    });
    return;
  }

  if (!profileSetupIsComplete()) {
    rotasticOpeningTickerActive = true;
    renderPersistentFirstSetupTicker();
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun) {
    if (!headlineTickerTimer && !rotasticOpeningTickerActive) {
      Promise.resolve(renderNextTickerSlot()).catch(function(e) {
        console.warn('ROTASTIC ticker resume:', e);
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticOpeningTickerActive) return;

  rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun = true;
  rotasticOpeningTickerActive = true;

  if (headlineTickerTimer) {
    clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = null;
  }
  if (rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer) {
    clearTimeout(rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer);
    rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer = null;
  }

  const data = getOpeningBriefingData();

  try {
    renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(data, 5000, false, true);
  } catch (e) {
    renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(getOpeningBriefingData(), 5000, false, true);
  }

  rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

    if (headlineTickerTimer) {
      clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
      headlineTickerTimer = null;
    }

    rotasticOpeningTickerActive = false;
    rotasticContentCycleIndex = 1;
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer = null;
  }, 5300);
}

function checkAndRenderBreakingNews() {
  // Unified priority stream:
  // During the first hour of an affected shift:
  // sick leave every 2 messages > prayer every 5 messages > admin notices > clinical/general.
  // After that first hour the sick alert loses ticker priority and normal rotation resumes.
  // Normal content follows the exact 11-step cycle defined in renderNextTickerSlot().
  if (headlineTickerTimer) {
    clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = null;
  }
  renderNextTickerSlot();
}

function getApprovedRotaMonthLabel() {
  try {
    const first = (currentSchedule || [])[0];
    const raw = first && (first.date || first.isoDate || first.dayDate);
    if (raw) {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {timeZone:'Asia/Qatar', month:'long', year:'numeric'}).format(new Date(raw));
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {timeZone:'Asia/Qatar', month:'long', year:'numeric'}).format(new Date());
}

function showMoursiApprovalExportPopup() {
  let modal = document.getElementById('moursiApprovalExportModal');
  if (!modal) {
    modal = document.createElement('div');
    modal.id = 'moursiApprovalExportModal';
    modal.className = 'fixed inset-0 z-[10050] hidden items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-4';
    modal.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-slate-900 p-5 shadow-2xl">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div class="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300"><i class="fa-solid fa-check-double"></i></div>
          <div>
            <h3 class="text-sm font-black text-white">Rota approved</h3>
            <p class="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400">The rota is now released to colleagues and they have been notified. Would you like to export the approved rota?</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <button class="rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-3 py-3 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-rose-500" onclick="completeMoursiApprovalExport('pdf')"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf mr-1.5"></i>PDF</button>
          <button class="rounded-xl bg-cyan-600 px-3 py-3 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-cyan-500" onclick="completeMoursiApprovalExport('png')"><i class="fa-regular fa-image mr-1.5"></i>PNG</button>
        </div>
        <button class="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700" onclick="completeMoursiApprovalExport('none')">Not now</button>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(modal);
  }
  modal.classList.remove('hidden');
  modal.classList.add('flex');
}

function completeMoursiApprovalExport(kind) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('moursiApprovalExportModal');
  if (modal) { modal.classList.add('hidden'); modal.classList.remove('flex'); }
  try {
    if (kind === 'pdf') exportToPDFReport();
    if (kind === 'png') exportToImageReport();
  } catch(e) { console.warn('Approved rota export:', e); }
  setTimeout(function() {
    const assign = confirm('Do you want to assign shift leads?');
    if (assign) {
      Storage.set('rotastic_shift_lead_assignment_after_approval', 'true');
      switchTab('generator');
      setTimeout(function() {
        const target = document.getElementById('assignShiftLeadAM');
        if (target) { target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'}); target.focus(); }
      }, 180);
    } else {
      Storage.set('rotastic_shift_lead_assignment_after_approval', 'false');
    }
  }, 250);
}

async function notifyEveryoneRotaApproved(workflow) {
  const uniqueDoctors = Array.from(new Set((DOCTORS || []).map(function(d){ return d.name; }).filter(Boolean)));
  const message = 'The physician rota for ' + getApprovedRotaMonthLabel() + ' has been approved by the Clinical Lead and is now available in your Rota view.';
  uniqueDoctors.forEach(function(name) {
    queueInAppNotification(name, message, 'rota-approved', {workflowId:workflow.id, action:'rota-approved'});
  });
  requestBrowserNotificationPermission();
  if (ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT) {
    try {
      await rotasticPushBackendFetch({
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json
